title: Left Rudder
summary: Trailing-edge directional control surface on the left vertical tail; also deflects outward in tandem with the right rudder as an aerodynamic speedbrake.
role: Provides yaw control and split-rudder aerodynamic braking without requiring a dedicated dorsal speedbrake door.
